system: Recombinant human DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit (P78527)

steps.instruction: Prepare a 10-point, 3-fold serial dilution of CHEMBL104468 starting from a top concentration, include vehicle (DMSO) control and a known inhibitor (e.g., NU7441) as positive control.
Mix diluted compound, kinase, peptide substrate, and ATP; incubate at 30 °C for 30 min.
Stop reaction, deplete residual ATP, add ADP-Glo detection reagent, incubate, measure luminescence.

rationale: ADP-Glo luminescence directly measures kinase activity; using ATP at 10 µM mirrors a prior DNA‑PK inhibition assay (CHEMBL1081312) ensuring comparable conditions. Serial dilution enables IC50 estimation without assuming potency.
limitations: Top concentration, enzyme and substrate concentrations are not supported by the input packet and must be empirically determined; using arbitrary values may affect assay window.
Vehicle fraction assumed typical for DMSO‑soluble compounds; actual solubility of CHEMBL104468 is unknown.
Luminescence readout reports bulk ADP production; does not distinguish between inhibition of DNA‑PK catalytic subunit versus upstream regulators if present in the recombinant preparation.
